People: Anton Schiefner (translator, Wikidata Q551620), died 1879; William Ralston Shedden Ralston (translator, Wikidata Q2343190), died 1889. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Schiefner, Anton, 1817-1879 [Translator]; Ralston, William Ralston Shedden, 1828-1889 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Tibetan tales, derived from Indian sources, London, K. Paul, Trench, Trübner & Co. Ltd., 1906, 1906, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/tibetantalesderi00schirich. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 81%, 85%, 100% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Ralston Shedden Ralston, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
